name: codex-claude-notify
description: Delivers Codex turn completions as native peer notifications to the launching Claude Code session over its authenticated Unix socket.

interface.shortDescription: Native Codex completion notifications in Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Delivers the final Codex response to the launching Claude Code session as a native named-peer notification. Uses an authenticated Unix socket, preserves UTF-8 within a 64 KiB message limit, and supports a configured Stop hook or legacy notify command. See the README for plugin-hook compatibility and installation requirements.
